_about: Shared test vectors for fiat payee details. commitments/invalid: read by recoilpay-intent-kit/packages/core/test/payee.test.ts and by oif_types::fiat_trades::payee in Rust; their commitments were computed independently with `cast keccak` over hex(canonical) || salt, not by either implementation. commitment = keccak256(utf8(canonical) || salt). sealedRecipient/sealed/roundtrip/payeeKey: generated by recoilpay-intent-kit/packages/core/scripts/gen-payee-vectors.ts from the real sealPayee envelope code and the dashboard's payeeKeyFromSignature; read by payee.test.ts and by the Merchant Agent (repo recoil-labs/merchant-agent, crates/agent-core/tests/payee.rs). A case's expect is what openPayee returns; error is a code shared by both languages. Every key, salt and account here is a fixed test value.
